caseNameFull: Barefoot v. Estelle, Director, Texas Department of Corrections

opinions.text: C. A. 5th Cir. [Certio-rari granted, 459 U. S. 1169.] Motion of Washington Legal Foundation for leave to file a brief as amicus curiae granted. Motion of Florida for leave to participate in oral argument as amicus curiae and for additional time for argument denied.
